source.content: @isTest private class ConnectApiCommerceTest { @isTest static void getCartSummary() { ConnectApi.CartSummary summary = ConnectApi.CommerceCart.getCartSummary('0ZE', '001-acc', '0cs-cart'); System.assertNotEquals(null, summary); } @isTest static void addItemToCart() { ConnectApi.CartItemInput input = new ConnectApi.CartItemInput(); ConnectApi.CartItem item = ConnectApi.CommerceCart.addItemToCart('0ZE', '001-acc', '0cs-cart', input); System.assertNotEquals(null, item); } @isTest static void addItemsToCart() { ConnectApi.BatchInput bi = new ConnectApi.BatchInput(); List<ConnectApi.BatchInput> inputs = new List<ConnectApi.BatchInput>{bi}; List<ConnectApi.BatchResult> results = ConnectApi.CommerceCart.addItemsToCart('0ZE', '001-acc', '0cs-cart', inputs); System.assertEquals(1, results.size()); } @isTest static void getCartItems() { ConnectApi.CartItemCollection items = ConnectApi.CommerceCart.getCartItems('0ZE', '001-acc', '0cs-cart'); System.assertNotEquals(null, items); } @isTest static void getProduct() { ConnectApi.ProductDetail product = ConnectApi.CommerceCatalog.getProduct('0ZE', '01t-prod', '001-acc', new List<String>{'Name'}, false, new List<String>(), false, false, false); System.assertNotEquals(null, product); } @isTest static void getProductPrice() { ConnectApi.ProductPrice price = ConnectApi.CommerceStorePricing.getProductPrice('0ZE', '01t-prod', '001-acc'); System.assertNotEquals(null, price); } @isTest static void getProductPrices() { ConnectApi.PricingInput pi = new ConnectApi.PricingInput(); ConnectApi.PricingResult result = ConnectApi.CommerceStorePricing.getProductPrices('0ZE', '001-acc', pi); System.assertNotEquals(null, result); ConnectApi.PricingResult resultWithCurrency = ConnectApi.CommerceStorePricing.getProductPrices('0ZE', '001-acc', pi, 'CAD'); System.assertNotEquals(null, resultWithCurrency); } }
